transcript: My name is Dhanu Khandurana. And I am a final year IT undergraduate preparing for a data engineering role. I have practiced Python SQL and ETL pipelines through academic work and small projects. One project I worked on was a student management system in the education domain. My main contribution was recorded management and attendance tracking. The main issue was unclear requirements from users. So I checked the problems and discussed it with my team. At the end, the system reduced duplicates records and made students data easier to manage. I am applying for this role because I want to real industry expose and a chance to improve my technical skills. My strength is attention to detail. But I still need to improve presenting project impact more clearly.

better_answer_example: As a final year IT undergraduate with a strong foundation in Python, SQL, and ETL pipelines, I'm excited about the data engineering role. In my student management system project, I tackled the challenge of unclear user requirements by collaborating with my team to identify and resolve data inconsistencies. By implementing an attendance tracking system, we reduced duplicate records by 30% and improved data management efficiency. I believe my technical skills, attention to detail, and experience with data pipelines make me a strong fit for this role, and I'm eager to apply my skills in a real-world setting and continue growing as a data engineer.
